talk.description: mouth shapes: closed / small / open / wide

listen.description: leans in, eyes look to the side

think.description: staff ring glows and orbits, ... dots

working.description: taps the staff like typing, sparks

celebrate.description: jump with sparkles bursting from the staff

surprised.description: hair spikes jump up, O mouth

sad.description: droops, the hair flops, a down mouth

error.description: droop plus a nervous shake, flat mouth

walk-left.description: walk cycle to the left (desktop pet)

walk-right.description: walk cycle to the right (desktop pet)

loading.description: tiny icon: just the staff ring spinning
